nodes.label: JQ-SUPPLY-001: Patched jQuery
nodes.rationale: jQuery MUST be patched; do not run known vulnerable versions.

nodes.label: JQ-XSS-001: jQuery HTML Insertion
nodes.rationale: Untrusted data MUST NOT be inserted as HTML via jQuery DOM-manipulation methods.

nodes.label: JQ-AJAX-001: JSONP Security
nodes.rationale: JSONP MUST be disabled unless the endpoint is fully trusted.

nodes.label: JQ-PROTOTYPE-001: Prototype Pollution
nodes.rationale: Do not deep-merge untrusted objects; prevent prototype pollution.
